rules.rule: One take per story; no cuts under 10 s. In longer reels a shot runs at least 4.5 s.
rules.number: board 0 cuts in 9.75 s; floor = feed p75 shot 4.54 s
rules.cite: motion.json board cuts; summary.json instagram shot_s_iqr

rules.rule: Lock the camera; motion comes from the subject. No digital zoom on filmed footage.
Graphic and product layers may move as the board does: drift, zoom in, hold, zoom out.
rules.number: zoom in 2.62-4.12 s to 4.47x, out 6.75-9.54 s, ends at 1.01x

rules.rule: Every move eases in and out; the way out is slower than the way in.
rules.number: out takes 1.9x as long as in

rules.rule: Keep the tempo slow outside the zoom.
rules.number: median 3.08 px/frame at 270 px wide (1.1% of width)

rules.rule: End on the opening framing without faking a seamless loop.
Text only where speech needs captions: one line at a time in the feed's caption band, cut on in place. Text reveals belong to title and end cards, not to footage.
rules.number: band 74.6-78.7% of height; 2057 of 3264 feed text events cut on
rules.cite: motion.json board text_on_screen_share; summary.json instagram text_box_*_median, text_arrivals

rules.rule: Footage takes the kit treatment; graphics use the still kit unchanged.
